failure.check: Rule change mid-cycle: POST /api/cases/{id}/final-bill 108000.00 on a case whose pre-auth was approved for 100000.00 under SILVER v1 (buffer 10%) -> 201 with cap 110000.00
reproduction: Fresh DB. Login cityhosp.desk, adjudicator.priya, admin.sam (Demo@1234)

cityhosp.desk POST /api/preauths {member_id:MBR-1001, policy_number:POL-SLV-0001, diagnosis_code:I21.9, estimated_cost:'100000.00', expected_admission_date:<tomorrow>} -> 201 PENDING, rule_version SILVER v1
admin.sam POST /api/admin/products/SILVER/coverage-rules with all v1 fields but buffer_pct '5' -> 201 version 2
failure.notes: GET /api/preauths/{id} still reports rule_version SILVER v1. The cap uses the current (v2) buffer instead of the pre-auth's recorded version. A later settle returns 422 FINAL_BILL_REQUIRED because no bill could be stored.
failure.stack_trace: none (handled 422; no exception in the server log)

failure.check: Bill accepted under one buffer is settled with the same cap: POST /api/cases/{id}/settle -> cap 110000.00, admissible 108000.00, settlement 92700.00
reproduction: Create and approve a pre-auth for 100000.00 under SILVER v1 (as in C-01a), then admit
admin.sam publishes SILVER v2 with buffer_pct '5' (all other fields as v1)
failure.notes: The hospital is underpaid by 2700.00, and the settlement row is append-only so it cannot be corrected. The bill was validated against cap 110000.00 but settled against cap 105000.00. Deductible and copay_pct are probably also read from the current version.

failure.check: POST /api/cases/{id}/close on a PRE_AUTH case whose pre-auth is not REJECTED -> 409 INVALID_CLAIM_STATE
reproduction: cityhosp.desk POST /api/preauths (I21.9, 100000.00) -> PRE_AUTH case, pre-auth PENDING
failure.notes: Reproduced for both APPROVED and PENDING pre-auths. The case correctly stays PRE_AUTH. PREAUTH_NOT_REJECTED is not defined anywhere in specs/. Per §6.2, PRE_AUTH -> CLOSED is allowed only when the pre-auth is REJECTED, and every other transition must raise InvalidClaimStateException (409).
